question: ______ is mainly derived from citrus fruits and juices such as lemons, oranges and sweet limes/mousambis.
solution:
The correct answer is __**​Vitamin C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin C:**

 
 
• **​Ascorbic acid is also called vitamin C.**
 
• It is soluble in water and is an essential chemical element for the human body.
 
• vitamin C is mainly found in fruits and vegetables.
 
• **It remains stable even in the air, but it oxidizes rapidly when mixed with a solution. **
 
• The empirical formula of ascorbic acid is **C₆H₁₂0****₆**.
